## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
RISK-ON: Low volatility (Vol: 19.5%) with mixed breadth (4/8 sectors positive), supporting selective risk-taking.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Transportation leading: TAVHL (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +2.19%) ABOVE TREND; Banking showing short-term strength: YKBNK (1W: +5.96% | 1M: -13.93%) RECOVERY and HALKB (1W: +5.59% | 1M: -17.33%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy & Chemicals lagging: GUBRF (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -10.45%) BELOW TREND and TRMET (1W: -5.68% | 1M: +8.98%) CORRECTION; Heavy Industry weak: ASELS (1W: -3.12% | 1M: -9.23%) BELOW TREND and VESTL (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
TKFEN (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +20.21%) ABOVE TREND; TAVHL (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +2.19%) ABOVE TREND; YKBNK (1W: +5.96% | 1M: -13.93%) RECOVERY; HALKB (1W: +5.59% | 1M: -17.33%) RECOVERY; TCELL (1W: +5.18% | 1M: -0.74%) RECOVERY.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
KONTR (1W: -10.17% | 1M: +33.75%) CORRECTION; TRMET (1W: -5.68% | 1M: +8.98%) CORRECTION; VESTL (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND; TRALT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND; EREGL (1W: -3.51% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Upside momentum: TKFEN (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +20.21%) ABOVE TREND and TAVHL (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +2.19%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum: KONTR (1W: -10.17% | 1M: +33.75%) CORRECTION and TRMET (1W: -5.68% | 1M: +8.98%) CORRECTION.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Banking shows a short-term rebound but mixed fundamentals: AKBNK (1W: +2.48% | 1M: -12.64%) RECOVERY, GARAN (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -4.91%) RECOVERY, ISCTR (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -15.05%) BELOW TREND — prefer selectively higher-quality names.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Industrial rotation uneven: FROTO (1W: +2.94% | 1M: -3.76%) RECOVERY and TOASO (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -11.02%) NEUTRAL show resilience while ASELS (1W: -3.12% | 1M: -9.23%) BELOW TREND and EREGL (1W: -3.51% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION need caution.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Sector under pressure on the week despite some month gains: TUPRS (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +21.04%) CORRECTION and PETKM (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION — trade selectively around oil and margin catalysts.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Risk-on stance: overweight Transportation and select Construction/retail cyclicals (e.g., TAVHL (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +2.19%) ABOVE TREND, TKFEN (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +20.21%) ABOVE TREND) and selective bank recoveries; trim momentum unwind candidates KONTR (1W: -10.17% | 1M: +33.75%) CORRECTION and weak heavy industry names ASELS (1W: -3.12% | 1M: -9.23%) BELOW TREND.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
TKFEN (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +20.21%) ABOVE TREND for continuation; TUPRS (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +21.04%) CORRECTION for margin/cargo catalysts; KONTR (1W: -10.17% | 1M: +33.75%) CORRECTION for volatility-driven moves; YKBNK (1W: +5.96% | 1M: -13.93%) RECOVERY for bank flow confirmation.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Transportation and Banking (flow-driven positives); Energy & Chemicals for macro/oil-driven reversals.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch XU100 momentum: confirmation if it holds recent breakout vs a failure below short-term support (watch global risk tone, CBRT comments, CPI and Q2 earnings releases); catalysts: domestic CPI prints, CBRT guidance, oil price moves and company-level earnings or guidance.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Low-volatility RISK-ON market with mixed sector participation; Transportation and select Construction/banks offer the clearest tactical opportunities. Main risks are abrupt reversals in weak heavy industry and energy names plus macro/currency shocks — trade selectivity and tight stops.
